{{nihongo|'''Oono Shrine'''|大野神社 (一宮市)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Owari Province]].

{{Unreferenced|date=2014th year 10月26日 (日) 11:02 (UTC)~}}
'''Ono Shrine''' (大野神社) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto Shrine|1=Shinto shrine}} located in {{ill|Aichi Prefecture|en|Aichi Prefecture|qid=Q80434|lt=Aichi Prefecture|1=Aichi Prefecture}}, {{ill|Ichinomiya, Aichi|en|Ichinomiya, Aichi|qid=Q270810|lt=Ichinomiya|1=Ichinomiya, Aichi}}, {{ill|Asai Town (Aichi Prefecture)|ja|浅井町 (愛知県)|lt=Asai Town|lt_ja=浅井町|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Asai Town (Aichi Prefecture)|1=Azai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11556970}}. Its former {{ill|Shrine Status|ja|社格|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shrine Status|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Shakaku|qid=Q10444029}} was that of a Village Shrine. It is situated to the south of {{ill|Ono Gokurakuji Park|ja|大野極楽寺公園|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ono Gokurakuji Park|1=Onogokurakuji Park|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11439660}} and beside the {{ill|Morio Embankment|ja|御囲堤|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Morio Embankment|1=Q11488847|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11488847}}.

It is the "Ono Shrine" of the {{ill|Warrant of Deities of the Engi Era|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|lt=Shikinaisha|lt_ja=式内社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Warrant of Deities of the Engi Era|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}} in {{ill|Owari Province|en|Owari Province|qid=Q514506|lt=Owari Province|1=Owari Province}}, {{ill|Haguri District|en|Haguri District|qid=Q1032507|lt=Haguri District|1=Haguri District}}.

== Overview ==
* The date of foundation is unknown. It is said that the original location was slightly to the south of the current site.
* It is believed that this was originally a shrine associated with water. Before the {{ill|Edo period|en|Edo period|qid=Q184963|lt=Edo period|1=Edo period}}, due to the enshrinement of {{ill|Hachiman|en|Hachiman|qid=Q261637|lt=Hotabebito no Mikoto|1=Hachiman}}, it was renamed as a Hachiman Shrine, but in {{ill|1870|en|1870|qid=Q7741|lt=1870|1=1870}} (the 3rd year of Meiji) it was renamed Ono Shrine.
* Part of the shrine grounds now house the Ono Community Center. Within the precincts, various stone statues (including {{ill|Divine Statue|ja|神像|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Divine Statue|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Idols in Shinto|qid=Q11588751}} and {{ill|Buddha in art|en|Buddha in art|qid=Q1000809|lt=Buddhist Statue|1=Buddha in art}}) and stone monuments—presumed to have once been enshrined—are scattered about.

** From {{ill|Meitetsu|ja|名鉄|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Meitetsu|1=Q11415661|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11415661}}’s {{ill|Meitetsu Nagoya Main Line|en|Meitetsu Nagoya Main Line|qid=Q1137838|lt=Nagoya Main Line|1=Meitetsu Nagoya Main Line}} and {{ill|Meitetsu Bisai Line|en|Meitetsu Bisai Line|qid=Q901005|lt=Meitetsu Onishi Line|1=Meitetsu Bisai Line}} at {{ill|Meitetsu Ichinomiya Station|en|Meitetsu Ichinomiya Station|qid=Q2856589|lt=Meitetsu Ichinomiya Station|1=Meitetsu Ichinomiya Station}}, or from the {{ill|Tōkaidō Main Line|ja|Tōkaidō Main Line|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tōkaidō Main Line|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} at {{ill|Owari-Ichinomiya Station|en|Owari-Ichinomiya Station|qid=Q871495|lt=Owari Ichinomiya Station|1=Owari-Ichinomiya Station}} (Platform 3 at the {{ill|Meitetsu Ichinomiya Station Bus Terminal|ja|名鉄一宮駅バスターミナル|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Meitetsu Ichinomiya Station Bus Terminal|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 一宮駅バスターミナル|1=Q11415757|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11415757}}) for the "Kawashima" bus.

== Japanese content ==
{{Citation needed|date=October 26, 2014 (Sun) 11:02 (UTC)~}}
'''Ōno Shrine''' (Ōno-jinja) is a {{ill|lt=Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945|1=Shinto shrine}} located in {{ill|lt=Asai Town (Aichi Prefecture)|Q11556970|qid=Q11556970|lt=Asai-chō|1=Azai}}, {{ill|lt=Ichinomiya City|Q270810|qid=Q270810|1=Ichinomiya, Aichi}}, {{ill|lt=Aichi Prefecture|Q80434|qid=Q80434|1=Aichi Prefecture}}. Its former {{ill|lt=shrine ranking system|Q10444029|qid=Q10444029|1=Shakaku}} status was that of a village shrine. It is located south of {{ill|lt=Ōno Gokurakuji Park|Q11439660|qid=Q11439660|1=Onogokurakuji Park}}, near the {{ill|lt=Okakoi embankment|Q11488847|qid=Q11488847|1=Okakoi embankment}}.

It is listed as the “Ōno Shrine” of {{ill|lt=Haguri District|Q1032507|qid=Q1032507|1=Haguri District}}, {{ill|lt=Owari Province|Q514506|qid=Q514506|1=Owari Province}} in the {{ill|lt=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Engishiki shrine register|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō}}.<ref>https://jmapps.ne.jp/kokugakuin/det.html?data_id=181383</ref>

=== Overview ===
* The date of establishment is unknown. It is said that the shrine was originally located slightly south of its present site.
* It is said to have originally been a shrine associated with water. Before the {{ill|lt=Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963|1=Edo period}}, after Hondawake no Mikoto was enshrined, it was renamed a Hachiman Shrine; however, in {{ill|lt=1870|Q7741|qid=Q7741|1=1870}} (Meiji 3), it was renamed Ōno Shrine.
* Part of the shrine grounds now serves as the Ōno Community Center. Within the grounds, stone statues ({{ill|lt=stone statues|Q12573007|qid=Q12573007|1=Stone sculpture}}—{{ill|lt=Shinto deity statues|Q11588751|qid=Q11588751|1=Idols in Shinto}}, {{ill|lt=Buddhist statues|Q1000809|qid=Q1000809|1=Buddha in art}}) and stone monuments, presumed to have once been worshipped, exist in a disorderly manner.

=== Enshrined Deities ===
;Main deities
:*{{ill|lt=Hachiman|Q261637|qid=Q261637|qid=Q317997|lt=Hondawake no Mikoto|1=Hachiman}}
:*{{ill|lt=Amaterasu Ōmikami|Q455602|qid=Q455602|1=Amaterasu}}
:*{{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Takemizuwake no Kami|1=UNKNOWN}} (presumed to be {{ill|UNKNOWN|qid=Q9150391|lt=Takeminakata no Kami|1=Takeminakata}})
;Enshrined together
:*{{ill|lt=Sugawara no Michizane|Q382005|qid=Q382005|1=Sugawara no Michizane}}

=== Transportation ===
* Get off at the “Ōno” bus stop on {{ill|lt=Meitetsu Bus|Q6810397|qid=Q6810397|1=Meitetsu Bus}}, then walk 3 minutes.
** From {{ill|lt=Meitetsu Ichinomiya Station|Q2856589|qid=Q2856589|1=Meitetsu Ichinomiya Station}} on the {{ill|lt=Nagoya Railroad|Q30850|qid=Q30850|1=Meitetsu}}{{ill|lt=Meitetsu Nagoya Main Line|Q1137838|qid=Q1137838|lt=Nagoya Main Line|1=Meitetsu Nagoya Main Line}} / {{ill|lt=Meitetsu Bisai Line|Q901005|qid=Q901005|lt=Bisai Line|1=Meitetsu Bisai Line}}, or from {{ill|lt=Owari-Ichinomiya Station|Q871495|qid=Q871495|1=Owari-Ichinomiya Station}} on the {{ill|lt=Tōkaidō Main Line|Q1190152|qid=Q1190152|1=Tōkaidō Main Line}} (Meitetsu Ichinomiya Station Bus Terminal, platform 3), take the bus bound for “Kawashima.”
